name: Fake Name Generator
summary: Generate synthetic first/last names for fixtures and mockups — locally in your browser.
description: Create 1–100 fake names with initials and optional usernames. Choose western-leaning or mixed name pools, use a seed for reproducible lists, and copy plain names or JSON. For development demos only.

faqs.question: Are these real people?
faqs.answer: No. Names are randomly combined from curated lists for placeholders and tests.

faqs.question: Can I get the same list again?
faqs.answer: Yes. Enable a deterministic seed so identical options produce identical output.

faqs.question: Is anything uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Generation runs entirely in your browser.
